identification.summary: Malpedia lists POISONUS PANDA as a separate actor entry whose cited reference is a 2016 CrowdStrike presentation, 'Detecting and Responding: Pandas and Bears' [S1]. Malpedia lists the same presentation under FOXY PANDA, which it describes as a group targeting telecommunication and technology organizations, and the MISP galaxy carries a Foxy Panda entry with that description [S2][S3]. The search results do not show whether the two names refer to one group.
identification.notes: Spelled 'POISONOUS PANDA' in one search summary and 'Poisonus Panda' in Malpedia's entry URL [S1]. No vendor page describing this actor was found. Do not merge facts with FOXY PANDA or any other PANDA cluster without a primary CrowdStrike source.

targeting.notes: The only targeting statement found (telecommunication and technology organizations) is attached to FOXY PANDA, not directly to POISONUS PANDA [S2][S3].

gaps: No dedicated public profile of POISONUS PANDA was found; only catalog entries (Malpedia, MISP galaxy) citing a 2016 CrowdStrike presentation.
The CrowdStrike presentation 'Detecting and Responding: Pandas and Bears' (Chris Scott and Wendi Whitmore, dated 2016-08-13 in Malpedia) could not be opened, so its content is unverified [S1].
Relationship between POISONUS PANDA and FOXY PANDA (alias, same group, or sibling entries) is unconfirmed.
Country, sponsor, tooling, victims, first-seen date and campaigns are unknown from the sources gathered.
The Malpedia and SANS summit PDF pages could not be fetched in this environment (host resolution failure); the imported SANS reference was not verified.
